app.name: ownership-and-efforts
app.description: Team ownership mapping and reliability effort tracking based on Davis problems

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Grail bucket metadata/definitions access, required alongside table-specific read scopes (e.g. storage:events:read) or queries return empty with a 'No bucket permissions' warning

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: Read HOST/SERVICE/K8S_DEPLOYMENT/FRONTEND Smartscape nodes for entity IDs and topology

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: Look up classic dt.entity.* tags (e.g. dt.owner) by id_classic, since Smartscape's own tags field omits custom/manual tags

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Read Davis problems (dt.davis.problems) to compute effort metrics like MTTR and problem counts

scopes.name: storage:system:read
scopes.comment: Read Automation Engine workflow execution events (dt.system.events) to count automations triggered per problem

scopes.name: settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: Read the native Dynatrace team catalog (builtin:ownership.teams) for the Teams page

scopes.name: settings:objects:write
scopes.comment: Create, edit, and delete teams in the native Dynatrace team catalog (builtin:ownership.teams)

scopes.name: storage:files:read
scopes.comment: Read the entity-team overrides lookup file (replaces the old override document) and other lookup-file management features

scopes.name: storage:files:write
scopes.comment: Create/update the entity-team overrides lookup file (Entities page saves) and the entity-team-assignments export (regenerate-entity-team-assignments function, called hourly by a scheduled workflow)

scopes.name: storage:files:delete
scopes.comment: Delete lookup files (Grail Resource Store) for future lookup-file management features

scopes.name: automation:workflows:write
scopes.comment: Create the private, undeployed team-import and sync-ownership-table workflow scaffolds from the Import Teams page
